en.title: Ship Three Packages at a Time in Queue Order
en.description:
The queue starts empty. INSERT appends a package ID to the end of the queue. SHIP, if the queue holds at least 3 packages, ships the earliest 3 and returns them in that order; otherwise it returns the single-element list ["N/A"] and removes no package. Return the list of results of every SHIP; if there is no SHIP, return an empty list.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The input is a compact JSON two-dimensional array whose items are ["INSERT",ID] or ["SHIP","-"]. The original statement gives no bounds on values or ID characters; on this site 1≤number of queries≤50000, and an ID has 0..16 Unicode characters, with spaces, empty names, duplicates and case differences allowed. Whitespace inside JSON strings must use JSON escapes, for example a space is written as \u0020, and non-ASCII characters use \uXXXX or surrogate pairs; the semantic strings are not shortened.
en.output: Output a compact JSON two-dimensional array; whitespace and non-ASCII characters in strings use JSON escapes, with a space encoded as \u0020.
en.explanation: The outputs are [["N/A"],["A","B","C"]]; the three packages unchanged, including an ID with a double space, an empty ID and an emoji; and [["N/A"]]. The N/ A in the original example is a display typo, and this site uses N/A throughout, as in the body.
hints: Keep all unshipped IDs in a deque; INSERT appends, and SHIP checks the length and then takes the first three or returns N/A.
